question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2
solution:
The correct answer is '**founded**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage is about Vijayanagara, a historic city and empire in South India.
 
• The word to fill in the blank should indicate the establishment of the empire in the fourteenth century.
 
• "**Founded**" fits well as it signifies the act of establishing or setting up the empire, fitting the historical context.
 
• Other options ("**begun**", "**implanted**", "**discovered**") do not appropriately capture the intended meaning of establishing an empire.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Vijayanagara or “city of victory” was the name__ of both a city and an empire. The empire was **__founded__** in the fourteenth century. In its heyday, it _____3______ from the river Krishna in the north to the extreme south of the peninsula. In 1565 the city was sacked and ______4______ deserted. Although it fell into ruin in the seventeenth-eighteenth centuries, it lived on in the memories of people living in the Krishna-Tungabhadra doab. They remembered it as Hampi, a name ________5______ from that of the local mother goddess, Pampadevi.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Begun **(शुरू किया): "Begun" means started, which does not specifically convey the formal establishment of an empire.
 
• **Implanted **(प्रत्यारोपित): "Implanted" means fixed or set securely or deeply, which is not suitable for the context of founding an empire.
 
• **Discovered **(खोज): "Discovered" means found unexpectedly or in the course of a search, which does not fit the context of establishing an empire.
